nodes.description: Nephrogenesis is disturbed late in gestation, so embryonal nephrogenic tissue persists at the periphery of the kidney as perilobar nephrogenic rests rather than completing nephron formation. The perilobar location contrasts with the intralobar rests of germline WT1 disease, which reflect an earlier disturbance.
